xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3232: Pending-input rendering drops the data the store already has: issue-view triangle structurally dead, prompt text rendered nowhere, wrong label, stale tree, specialists invisible

plan.title: Pending-input rendering drops the data the store already has: issue-view triangle structurally dead, prompt text rendered nowhere, wrong label, stale tree, specialists invisible
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: PAN-3068/3070/3051 made pending-input detection and classification work end-to-end: the store's agentsById snapshots carry hasPendingQuestion, pendingQuestionPrompt, pendingQuestionReason, and pendingInputKinds for blocked agents. Five render-layer defects drop that data before display: (1) toSessionNode omits the awaitingInput fields so the issue-view triangle/waiting-dot/tooltip are structurally dead; (2) pendingQuestionPrompt has zero JSX render sites so Decisions cards show a constant label instead of the actual question; (3) SessionPanel derives its kind label from the Channels-only selector (empty under the PTY supervisor) so permission prompts read 'Question waiting'; (4) mapEventToDelta emits no tree delta for agent.enrichment_changed so the sidebar badge lags up to ~70s; (5) specialist nodes (review/reviewer/test/ship) never set awaitingInput/pendingInputKinds in either the session-tree or the activity route.
narratives.Proposal: Fix each drop at the exact seam where the data is lost, per the PRD at drafts/pan-3232.md: copy the fields in toSessionNode and set pendingInputKinds in the activity route; thread pendingQuestionPrompt/Reason through PendingInputSubject → Decision → DecisionRow reviving getPendingQuestionTitle; prefer session.pendingInputKinds in SessionPanel; add an optional issueId to AgentEnrichmentChangedEvent and a new pending_input_changed SessionTreeDelta merged in place client-side; apply awaitingInputFromProjection to specialist nodes in both routes and buildReviewerNodes. Cleanups: remove the dead projectPendingInput and route the three direct selectPendingInputSubjects readers through usePendingInputSubjects.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No server-side classification changes (detection/classifier defects are filed separately per the issue)
- No change to GodView/AgentCard.tsx — verified already merging enrichment kinds with the Channels-derived kind (AD-4)
- No recovery-path changes (PAN-3228 owns 'recovery must not destroy needs_input agents')
- No new shared module for awaitingInputFromProjection — keep the existing per-route duplication pattern
- No new polling loops or refetchInterval additions; FR-4 is push-based only
- No conversation-side prompt threading (conversation rows carry no enrichment prompt; AUQ payloads already render)

autoDecisions.summary: Remove projectPendingInput and its test instead of wiring an owner
autoDecisions.rationale: agentSnapshotFromOverdeck (read-model.ts:403) never populates pending-input fields, so the bootstrap-strip scenario the function guards is structurally impossible; the issue itself offers 'decide its owner or remove it'.

autoDecisions.summary: Carry issueId as an optional field on AgentEnrichmentChangedEvent.payload rather than resolving agent→issue inside ws-rpc
autoDecisions.rationale: mapEventToDelta is pure and synchronous with an existing early-return on missing payload.issueId; the enrichment poller already holds agent.issueId at both emit sites, and Schema.optional preserves append-only replay compatibility.

autoDecisions.summary: Introduce a new SessionTreeDelta kind 'pending_input_changed' that merges fields in place client-side
autoDecisions.rationale: The invalidate-refetch path used by session_added would refetch-storm because shouldForceReemitPendingInput re-emits every ~3s for idle-alive waiting agents; an idempotent in-place merge is the only shape that satisfies NFR-1.

autoDecisions.summary: Scope defect 3 to CommandDeck/SessionView/SessionPanel.tsx; AgentCard unchanged
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified at HEAD that GodView/AgentCard.tsx:222-233 already gates on isAwaitingInput (fires from enrichment) and merges agent.pendingInputKinds into its tooltip; the issue's cited Channels-only pattern no longer exists there.

autoDecisions.summary: DecisionRow prompt precedence: AUQ question → plan copy → enrichment prompt via getPendingQuestionTitle → describePendingInput
autoDecisions.rationale: getPendingQuestionTitle (pipeline-state.ts:35) was written exactly for this formatting and is currently dead code; reviving it avoids reimplementing first-line/prefix logic and keeps one formatting owner.

autoDecisions.summary: Specialist fix covers both duplicated routes plus buildReviewerNodes, using projection-only reads
autoDecisions.rationale: Both routes/projects.ts and routes/command-deck.ts render specialist nodes with the same gap; specialists are registered agents covered by the enrichment poller, so the tmux-pane fallback used for work agents is unnecessary cost.

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-4, one vertical slice producer→consumer: (1) add issueId: Schema.optional(IssueId) to AgentEnrichmentChangedEvent.payload in contracts events.ts — MUST be optional, the event store is append-only and required fields break replay decode (hazard H1); (2) emit issueId: agent.issueId at the poller emit site (agent-enrichment-service.ts:301) and thread issueId into buildPendingReapEvent (:120) via a new parameter, omitting when a caller lacks it (hazard H3); (3) extend SessionTreeDelta in contracts rpc.ts (:226-234) with the 'pending_input_changed' kind literal plus optional awaitingInput/awaitingInputPrompt/awaitingInputReason/pendingInputKinds fields; (4) add the agent.enrichment_changed case to mapEventToDelta in ws-rpc.ts (:577-648) returning that delta, keeping the shared early-return on missing issueId; (5) in CommandDeck/index.tsx export applySessionTreeDelta and add a pending_input_changed branch that OVERWRITES all four fields on the matched session even when a delta field is absent, so cleared prompts clear (hazard H4) — never invalidateQueries for this kind (hazard H2). Rebuild packages/contracts before typechecking dependents (hazard H6). Parallel-safe despite complexity: this slice owns contracts/events.ts, contracts/rpc.ts, agent-enrichment-service.ts, ws-rpc.ts, and CommandDeck/index.tsx exclusively — no other plan item touches any of these files (see file-overlap matrix).

items.title: The AgentEnrichmentChangedEvent schema accepts payloads both with and without issueId, and decoding a legacy payload without the field returns a valid event

applySessionTreeDelta merges the four pending-input fields onto the matched session and clears them when the delta omits them, returning the same tree object when no session matches
The enrichment poller emits issueId on agent.enrichment_changed events for agents with a known issue

metadata.sizeJustification: All eight items patch one feature plane — pending-input surfacing — and interlock on the same files (command-deck.ts appears in two items; contracts types feed three). Splitting into sibling issues would create cross-issue merge conflicts on identical hunks while each item here is independently reviewable and mergeable within one branch.
